dataset_name: IMM Face Database local 73 JPEG / 13 IDs
dataset_source: Existing local original JPEG; DTU dataset via historical OpenIMAJ mirror; archive hash is self-computed, not publisher-authenticated
portability: Relative paths resolve only against source_roots; root binding is machine-specific
reserve_policy: Image6 only; never active or automatic replacement
pixel_hash_algorithm: SHA256(canonical ASCII JSON sorted compact {shape,dtype,order} + NUL + RGB C-order bytes); IMREAD_UNCHANGED; no EXIF transpose

provenance.identity_basis: Phase5B.3A original_identity_labels + source manifest + ASF host
